title: Track Guide Oulton Park Fosters Mazda MX5 Rookie iRacing

corners.braking: Brake at banner, 55% pressure, off brake to middle of track
corners.line: Cut inside curb, roll into corner
corners.exit: Accelerate on exit, stay within white line

corners.label: T4
corners.line: Turn in at inside curb, anti-cut curb
corners.exit: Ease in throttle to avoid understeer

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: brake once over dust, 50%, ease off until first curve
corners.line: use inside curbing to help exit

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: brake at hill top, 80%, ease off until emergency road

general_tips: Stay on left side of track for T1
End up on right side of track for T2
drive wide on entry, narrow on exit
use left side of track for turn eight
use left side of track for turn nine
